name: Commander Vaishura
notes: An ancient Asura vanguard commander who led the first crossing through the Dwarka Gate. He engineered the Asuran Agricultural Revolution, selectively breeding Permian synapsids to serve as war mounts and draft animals. The same Vaishura also held the Danava title Keeper of Forbidden Records; this is one individual with multiple historical offices, not a second character. The order and dates of these offices remain unresolved, as does how the Danava designation relates to the repository's existing Asura species classification. Preserve the Fang Vanguard history and deceased status.
sources: Gondwana: The Asura Intervention and the Fang Wars
